items.name: execute
items.description: Runs JavaScript code to interact with the Coingecko API. You are a skilled TypeScript programmer writing code to interface with the service. Define an async function named "run" that takes a single parameter of an initialized SDK client and it will be run. For example: ``` async function run(client) { const price = await client.simple.price.get({ vs_currencies: 'usd', ids: 'bitcoin' }); } ``` You will be returned anything that your function returns, plus the results of any console.log statements. items.name: query-docs
items.description: Retrieves and queries up-to-date documentation and code examples from Context7 for any programming library or framework. You must call 'Resolve Context7 Library ID' tool first to obtain the exact Context7-compatible library ID required to use this tool, UNLESS the user explicitly provides a library ID in the format '/org/project' or '/org/project/version' in their query. Do not call this tool more than 3 times per question.

input.name: libraryId
input.description: Exact Context7-compatible library ID (e.g., '/mongodb/docs', '/vercel/next.js', '/supabase/supabase', '/vercel/next.js/v14.3.0-canary.87') retrieved from 'resolve-library-id' or directly from user query in the format '/org/project' or '/org/project/version'.

input.name: query
input.description: What to look up in the library's documentation, scoped to a single concept. items.description: Resolves a package/product name to a Context7-compatible library ID and returns matching libraries. You MUST call this function before 'Query Documentation' tool to obtain a valid Context7-compatible library ID UNLESS the user explicitly provides a library ID in the format '/org/project' or '/org/project/version' in their query. input.name: query

items.name: get_chart
items.description: Get historical OHLCV price data (and optionally dividend/split events) for a symbol over a date range.

input.name: events
input.description: Events to include, pipe-separated, e.g. 'div|split'.

input.name: includePrePost
input.description: Whether to include pre/post-market data, default false.

input.name: interval
input.description: Candle interval, default 1d. Intraday intervals only support recent date ranges.

input.name: period1
input.description: Start of the range, e.g. 2024-01-01 or an ISO datetime.

input.name: period2
input.description: End of the range, e.g. 2024-12-31 or an ISO datetime; defaults to now.

input.name: symbol
input.description: Yahoo Finance ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, BTC-USD, EURUSD=X, ^GSPC.
